method: Dark Khmer-theme redesign (user request). Every final master page rendered at 120 dpi and inspected in tool output at readable size in groups of four. Supporting PDFs are exact extractions verified by verify.py. Page 19 PoLong cards now use the user-supplied portrait (assets/art/newpolong.jpg); page 19 re-rendered at 90 dpi and inspected. All other pages are unchanged from the prior inspected build.
